title: keyboard: no skip link — about 60 Tab presses to reach a list's New button, and Create/Edit dialogs focus Close first
body:
Filing gate: **① a user-visible UX defect with a named landing point and a reproduction** (`pm:queue` class).
Reader: the objectui lane owning `packages/app-shell (sidebar nav, dialogs)` — the fix PR there.
Dedupe (open AND closed, semantic search on objectstack-ai/objectui): "skip to main content link keyboard sidebar tab order" → 8 hits (top: #12795, #12744, #12429, #12427, #11395); none covers this item.

reach: measured in the console UX walkthrough — stock showcase with `--seed-admin`, framework objectstack-ai/objectstack@54159fd742e5, console pin objectui@12dc7b47c340 (dist stamp equal to the pin), Chromium at 1440x900; re-checked against objectui main source at df943a2a1af3 when found and ed28057 when split (the cited files are unchanged between the two).
type: Bug

Split out of #13115 (item 9), which folded fifteen independent defects into one card under the per-fire filing quota, which the maintainer has since ruled does not bind a concentrated test run such as a walkthrough. Split by the 18.0 QA wave dispatch session `session_01CfRDy7SuTfUqaTu2AEH2Hi`, on the maintainer's instruction there, verbatim: 「#13115 你可以拆」.

## Where

Showcase → Contacts, keyboard only from page load.

## Actual

The focus order walks the app bar, then every sidebar item twice (the link and its "More actions for …" button), so "New" is about the 60th stop; there is no skip link. In the opened Create/Edit dialogs the first focus is the Close button, not the first field. Saving a new record by keyboard does work once you get there.

## Expected

A "Skip to content" link as the first stop, and dialog focus on the first editable field.

## Source

No skip link anywhere in `packages/app-shell`, `packages/layout` or `apps/console` (a grep for "Skip to" finds nothing); sidebar items are in `packages/app-shell`'s sidebar nav (`sidebar-item-menu-trigger`).
